requirement.description: RLP encoding/decoding functions are not correctly handling all test cases, particularly around string and hex data handling. Several tests are failing due to incorrect hex conversion and encoding logic.
requirement.contract: Fix the RLP encoding and decoding functions to properly handle: 1. String data encoding with correct length prefixes 2. Hex string data processing with proper '0x' prefix handling 3. List encoding with correct length prefixes 4. Decoding of various data types (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex) 5. Proper handling of edge cases like empty strings and zero values

requirement.description: Missing import dependencies for cryptographic functions. Tests requiring ecdsa and hashlib are failing due to import errors.
requirement.contract: Ensure cryptographic functions properly handle missing dependencies: 1. Add proper import error handling with informative messages for ecdsa and hashlib 2. Implement fallback mechanisms when dependencies are missing 3. Make sure all cryptographic functions properly validate input parameters

requirement.description: RLP encoding function has incorrect logic for handling different str_modes and data types. The implementation is overly complex and contains several bugs in the manual encoding logic.
requirement.contract: Refactor the rlp_encode function to: 1. Simplify the logic flow for handling different data types 2. Fix the handling of hex strings and their prefixes 3. Ensure consistent behavior across different str_modes 4. Improve error handling and validation

requirement.description: RLP decoding functions have incomplete implementation for handling different data types and missing proper fallbacks.
requirement.contract: Improve the rlp_decode function to: 1. Properly handle decoding of all supported types (ascii, raw_hex, prefix_hex) 2. Implement robust fallback logic when rlp package is not available 3. Correctly parse and return decoded data in expected formats

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect function signatures for some cryptographic functions, causing test failures in signature-related tests.
requirement.contract: Correct function signatures and implementations for: 1. pack_vrs function to properly handle V, R, S values and format them correctly 2. Ensure consistent return types and parameter handling across all crypto functions
